'''July 2001 Sheridan tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed held in Sheridan, Wyoming on 27 July 2001. Peter won it. It is known from Travis Rumans's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2722">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-28-7-28-01-billings-mt-i-suckd2722/ 7-28-01-billings-mt-i-suck], DeckTech (Travis "Com Igar" Rumans, 28 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-28-7-28-01-billings-mt-i-suckd2722/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Sheridan, Wyoming
* '''Format:''' [[Reflections II Booster Draft]]
* '''Winner:''' Peter
